paid_market_gaps.gap: SOC 2 platforms start around $8.5k-$15k/year before a $10k-$50k audit; unaffordable for sub-10-person firms handling low-risk data
No-IT micro businesses and nonprofits lack a guided, done-for-you program; platforms assume an engineer to integrate and remediate
Awareness training priced from 25-seat bands and 3-year terms; Microsoft phishing simulation locked to E5/Defender Plan 2
SaaS vendors gate SSO behind enterprise tiers, inflating small-company security costs 3x-10x

wtp_evidence: Customer-driven SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials demand sustains public-priced products ($7.5k-$15k/yr platforms, £320+ certification, ~$2.40/seat/month training), but micro firms resist and renewal price complaints are common.
bundling_note: Clouds don't bundle SOC 2 automation, but governments give free prep (NCSC action plan, CISA scanning) and Microsoft bundles training in higher tiers.
summary: Crowded, well-funded compliance-automation and training markets serve funded startups; the opening is a cheap, done-for-you program for sub-20-person firms and nonprofits without IT, likely sold through MSPs or bundled with certification.
